summaries.en: Hyperframes is an open-source TypeScript framework that turns HTML animations into videos, purpose-built for AI agents. It bridges web animation and video production by rendering HTML/CSS (including libraries like GSAP) through Puppeteer, then encoding frames with FFmpeg. Its MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets language models directly control the rendering pipeline. You can craft video scenes as HTML templates and let an agent assemble dynamic presentations, product demos, or motion graphics—making programmatic video generation accessible and scriptable.
summaries.zh: Hyperframes 是一款 TypeScript 编写的开源框架，专为 AI 代理设计，核心理念是“编写 HTML，渲染视频”。它通过 Puppeteer 在浏览器中逐帧捕获 HTML/CSS 动画（如配合 GSAP 的复杂动效），再交给 FFmpeg 编码成视频，解决网页动画到视频文件的转化问题。其独特之处是支持 MCP 接入，使 AI 模型可直接驱动生成流程。实际使用中可将每个镜头写成 HTML 模板，由代理组织内容，自动生成产品演示、动态信息图等，让视频制作可编程、可自动化。

summaries.en: Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF is a quantized version of the Qwen3.8-27B large language model, optimized for local and edge deployment. By using GGUF format, it shrinks storage and memory requirements without sacrificing core reasoning quality, making powerful generative AI practical on consumer hardware. The quantization is enhanced with imatrix calibration, preserving accuracy better than naive rounding. It runs seamlessly with llama.cpp, LM Studio, and similar tools. Typical use cases include offline chat assistants, private document analysis, or embedding into apps where cloud APIs are costly or undesirable. You can download it and start experimenting on your own machine right away.

summaries.en: **summary_en** OTel-2.0-LLM-31B-IT is a 31-billion-parameter instruction-tuned multimodal model built to handle telecom industry tasks like network troubleshooting, technical document understanding, and visual question answering. It combines image-text-to-text capabilities with a strong Gemma-based backbone, trained in collaboration with GSMA, AT&T, Microsoft, and other carriers. Practically, you can load it via Hugging Face Transformers to automate network diagnostics, summarize engineering documentation, or fine-tune it further on proprietary telecom data for internal support systems. (81 words) **summary_zh** OTel-2.0-LLM-31B-IT是一个面向电信行业的开放多模态大模型，目标是让AI真正理解并处理网络运维、故障诊断和工程文档等专业任务。它基于Gemma架构，拥有310亿参数，并支持图像与文本联合输入——这意味着用户可以直接上传网络拓扑图、设备截图或故障告警，让模型结合图文上下文给出判断。该模型由GS
